import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_population_estimates_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='NST-EST2023-POP', header=None)
# Col A is Geographic Area, Col F (index 5) is 2023 population estimate
texas_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.replace('^\.', '', regex=True) == 'Texas']
result = int(texas_row.iloc[0, 5])

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_population_estimates_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='NST-EST2023-POP', header=None)
regions = ['Northeast', 'Midwest', 'South', 'West']
region_df = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().isin(regions)].copy()
region_df[5] = pd.to_numeric(region_df[5])
top3 = region_df.sort_values(by=5, ascending=False).head(3)
result = top3[0].str.strip().tolist()

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_population_estimates_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='NST-EST2023-POP', header=None)
ne_pop = float(df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Northeast'].iloc[0, 5])
mw_pop = float(df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Midwest'].iloc[0, 5])
result = 'Midwest' if mw_pop > ne_pop else 'Northeast'

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_population_estimates_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='NST-EST2023-POP', header=None)
# States and DC start with a dot (rows 10 to 60)
state_rows = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.startswith('.')].copy()
# Exclude Puerto Rico
state_rows = state_rows[state_rows[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.replace('^\.', '', regex=True) != 'Puerto Rico']
state_rows[5] = pd.to_numeric(state_rows[5])
result = int((state_rows[5] >= 10000000).sum())

pop_2023 = float(us_row[5])

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_population_estimates_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='NST-EST2023-POP', header=None)
targets = ['California', 'Texas', 'Florida']
clean_names = df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.replace('^\.', '', regex=True)
rows = df[clean_names.isin(targets)]
result = int(pd.to_numeric(rows[5]).sum())
